value.rationale: Hamming graphs form a canonical two-parameter product family for semidiscrete heat equations. The full exact positivity frontier has a motivated structure: one-dimensional clique cutoff, small positive Cartesian-product exceptions, explicit dimension/alphabet failures, and universal diameter-five small-step failure. The topology-sensitive classification is not a scalar SSP radius restatement or an arbitrary finite slice, and its spectral-projector proof gives reusable structural tests for other rational time filters.
